scope: Proposition 3.4 (Comparison gives a parametrized bundle embedding) of the manuscript “Radius of comparison equals half the mean dimension” (preprints/Radius-of-comparison-equals-half-the-mean-dimension-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 302 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1097583ea21e73e4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let r be a com- parison bound for A. Fix positive integers p, g, k, H0 with H0 ≥ 2, numbers 0 < a < 1/16 and b0 > 0, and an integer R such that RH0 pg(H0 − 1) + 2(a + b0) < 2, R − pg k > r. (3.7) Let F1, . . . , Fg : X → [−1, 1]t be arbitrary continuous maps. Choose B, (Oi)k−1 i=0 , w, K as in Lemma 3.2, with γ = R − pg and e = kH0. For all sufficiently large integers J, put N = eJ, n = J(H0 − 1)g. There is a continuous map fJ : X → [−1, 1]tn, with slots indexed by (q, D, j), 0 ≤ q < J, 0 ≤ D ≤ H0 − 2, 1 ≤ j ≤ g, such that (fJ )q,D,j(x) = Fj(hqe+i+Dk x) when hqe x ∈ Oi and w(hqe x) > 0. (3.8) The agreement holds, more strongly, on a neighborhood of each compact set h−qe(supp(w) ∩ Oi). Over the compact space LJ = {(x, z) ∈ X × Zan(t, n) : fJ (x) − z ∈ Ln }, (3.9) the direct sum of the n pullbacks of H, by the slot maps (x, z) 7→ (fJ )α(x) − zα, embeds continuously in a trivial complex bundle of rank strictly less than 2pn. The same allocation B, (Oi), w, K works for every such J.
